operations.name: VECTOR_REALLOC
operations.arguments: token old or0; a new logical extent>0; b exact prior extent (or0); c/fd/fs0
operations.policy: Map's monotonically growing pointer-vector allocation only. Reserve bookkeeping capacity first, raw anonymous mmap, copy full old logical bytes once, old munmap once, issue fresh token. Allocation failure retains old token/memory. Cleanup failure quarantines old memory and succeeds with new token.

operations.policy: One MAP_SHARED actual mmap. HIA parent must derive raw FD from actual current FS owner state under an exclusive borrow and protect the lease through completion.

operations.name: ZERO_HEAP
operations.policy: One zero-initialized anonymous mmap; logical ownership is the process-lock SHM heap equivalent.

operations.policy: HIA requires page-round(a)==recorded full actual mapping span, preserves original nominal32768 syscall length on64KiB systems. One attempt; on failure token is consumed into quarantine and errno returned for caller's original ignore policy.

operations.name: FREE
operations.arguments: live vector/heap token; a exact logical extent; rest0
operations.policy: One actual munmap of the allocation. Retire logical token once; known failure retains quarantine, no retry.

operations.name: BARRIER
operations.policy: One primitive providing actual memory fence plus the fixed executor's process-local global-lock barrier. This source does not assert that a merely echoed header provided a barrier.

workspace.growth: Append one80-byte bookkeeping row or reuse an all-zero retired row; no global count/byte quota. Fixed GROW must preserve complete workspace and re-enter same immutable request. No primitive replay.

invariants: Every live/quarantine record has unique token and disjoint actual range; no wrap in address/range arithmetic.
Every primitive completion carries exact source event/current call/action/lease and actual strictly increasing serial.
Unmap consumes once. Quarantine cannot issue a VIEW, be reused as a free row, or silently authorize a later allocation at overlapping address.
Realloc allocation/copy occurs before consuming old token. Unknown copy/primitive outcome poisons and retains resources for process exit.
Parent/fixed carrier remain responsible for actual provenance, live FD binding and mechanical address guards. No public authentication is inferred from headers.
